miniProject.title: One custom path running in a real inference endpoint
miniProject.brief: Integrate one validated CUDA or Triton path into a real operator or small endpoint on your GPU: trace dispatch to the kernel, measure paged KV and chunked prefill, cover quantized and speculative paths, and gate releases with fallback and rollback. Size all work to fit your GPU's memory; run paths it lacks as reading only. Build with `-arch=native`.
steps: Trace one `aten::mm` entry to its kernel on an `nsys` timeline, reconciling profiler time with kernel intervals and wall time. Run the regional-compile pair and attribute which boundary each variant moves.

Time eager launches against graph replay with interleaved trials, recording host load; replay must not lose on this shape, with recapture after any shape change. Keep capture logs and test eager fallback on an unsupported path.

Work a mixed batch of short and long decodes under static and continuous batching, stating which kernel dimensions shrink as slots free. Derive per-token KV bytes for your config, place one sequence into blocks, and keep block tables with hit rates.

Chunk one long prompt beside decodes under a token budget you set, showing per-iteration latency falls while attention work holds. Pass LeetGPU challenges 87 and 96 in your own harness, and compare disaggregated prefill and decode with TTFT, TPOT and transfer notes.

Time encoder-batch against decoder-only execution for one image-plus-text request, with a prefix-hash check reusing only matching prefixes. Integrate one validated kernel as a custom op, compare it against production baselines under a load test, with workspace planning, and derive capacity for your GPU.

Prove greedy equivalence and gate quality with perplexity on a fixed token file before and after the change. Write the versioned gate with fallback and rollback, seed one defect to show it failing, and drill rollback with raw samples kept.
deliverables: Dispatch and launch evidence: the operator-to-kernel trace, eager against replay trials, and batching and KV derivations.
The integrated custom op with workspace plan, capacity math, baselines and the multimodal timing check.
The quality gate on a fixed token file and the versioned regression gate with rollback drill.

checks.name: LeetGPU inference kernels run locally
checks.note: Pass 83 Fused Residual Add RMS Norm, 87 Speculative Decoding Verification and 96 INT8 KV Cache Attention in your harness; integrate one result with fallback.

rubric.pass: The trace follows one operator entry to its kernel with reconciled times, and eager against replay medians come from interleaved trials with recapture rules.
rubric.strong: Block tables show which reuse actually happened.

rubric.pass: The custom op runs in the endpoint with stable buffers named, capacity math states its conventions, production baselines are compared under load, and quality gates pass on a fixed token file.
rubric.strong: The report bounds the end-to-end win from the measured step share.

rubric.pass: Your own tests fail the gate on the seeded defect before timing, fallback routes correctly, and rollback is drilled with raw samples kept.
rubric.strong: The multimodal check reuses only matching prefixes and never the image blocks.

miniProject.feedsInto: Capstone integration: the endpoint, workspace plan, quality gate and regression gate with rollback become the system-level evidence. Communication and portability sections build on its shapes.
